hypothesis: Adding the observed ordinal boundary pattern may improve explanation-dependent scores; score improvement is not assumed.
development_evidence: Original water explanation, inherited without inspecting held-out scoring examples.
Own Qwen3-4B ordinal activation experiments, including multilingual and different-token observations and neighboring-ordinal counterexamples.
evaluation_policy: Freeze explanation before inspecting T2375 historical held-out example texts or obtaining new judge outputs.
Use identical held-out contexts, highlight masks, few-shots, token rendering, generation settings and judge version for baseline and candidate.
Refresh baseline and candidate with the same available judge; report historical and refreshed scores separately.
Do not replace the canonical dashboard explanation until a comparison is reviewable.
Report Detection, Fuzz and Active Fuzz accuracy and paired changes, including regressions, parse failures and confusion counts.
Intruder does not use the explanation; retain it as an explanation-independent control and do not claim text-induced improvement.
New diagnostic examples used to write the explanation are not held-out evidence for its generalization.
